premises.text: Traditional arid-climate farming wastes freshwater while producing little food, forcing consumers to choose low-quality seasonal local produce or expensive air-freighted imports
premises.evidence_span: Traditional farming on such a piece of land is incredibly inefficient, both in terms of resource utilization and, of course, the quality of production

premises.text: IoT-enabled triple-play climate management (mechanical, evaporative, and high-pressure fogging) with CO2 dosing creates a controlled greenhouse corridor that grows diverse crops anywhere with high sweetness and chemical-free pest protection via beneficial insects
premises.evidence_span: an IoT-enabled triple-play climate management system that uses mechanical, evaporative, and a high-pressure fogging cooling system, all controlled from one brain

premises.text: The system delivers several times higher yield with a fraction of the water versus local open production and beats unsustainable long-haul European imports on proximity
premises.evidence_span: Our solution is seven times. 7 to 10 times the yield using 1 7th of the water

premises.text: Go-to-market is direct to retailers and wholesalers, collapsing a typical five-step distribution channel into two
premises.evidence_span: we'll access the market going direct to retailers and wholesalers, eliminating what is typically a five-step distribution channel into just two

value.text: Fresh, premium, always-available produce grown sustainably locally at materially lower cost than air-freighted imports
value.evidence_span: producing a wide variety of crops, sustainably grown, always available, and at a materially lower cost than air-freighted imports

secondary_value.text: Regional food security, water conservation, and economic diversification
secondary_value.evidence_span: any country can invest in its own food security, water conservation, and economic diversification

climate-agnostic technology solution for food security anywhere in the world
going direct to retailers and wholesalers
